summary: Canonical POA and MCP registry of commands, URI processes, and URN resources

delivery.outcome: `fixos/poa_registry.py` provides the single canonical POA/MCP capability registry separating `operation_id`, `process_uri`, and `resource_urn`, exporting `wellmanifest.mcp/registry/v1`, validating uniqueness/freshness/availability, and enforcing parity across all Click commands, subcommands, and builtin plugins (closing #164).
nonGoals: Input-bound receipt journals and post-cleanup read-back are delivered separately in #163.
MCP resources/list and resources/read endpoints are delivered separately in #165.

architecture.decision: Create `fixos/poa_registry.py` as the SSOT for canonical `OperationSpec` and `NonExposedCapability` records, project `OPERATIONS_CATALOG`, `registry_search`, `mcp_tools_list`, and `task_execute` in `fixos/mcp_server.py`, add `--registry-v1` to `fixos/cli/mcp_cmd.py`, and gate CLI/plugin parity with `verify_capability_parity()`.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-151 commit to restore static 4-item `OPERATIONS_CATALOG`.

validation.evidence: All Click commands, subcommands, and builtin plugins pass parity and v1 schema conformance checks.
MCP server discovery, validation, and stdio roundtrips pass.
Governance, ruff, and scope checks pass.
